quests.title: Good Hunter Express

dialogue.sit: I have other things to do.

dialogue.t: Okay. I'll look for someone else to help out...
That would be great, thank you!
Please be careful while you make the delivery. Don't let any strange elements touch the food.
Also, do your best to avoid monsters, or they might knock the dish over.
Please hurry, this dish won't taste good if it gets cold.

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Short-Tempered Wallit

dialogue.t: Why hasn't my order arrived yet... What's with all this dilly-dallying, anyway?

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: Yup, you've come at just the right moment — I'd just finished preparing this Sweet Madame.
Wallit ordered it earlier, and requested that we deliver it to a location west of the Dawn Winery later in the day...
If you don't mind helping us out, could you take his order to him real quick?
Oh, finally! Thank you, thank you.
I've got to finish this quickly. I still have a ton of things to do...

quests.description: The Good Hunter has a special order that needs sending out...
